caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, three-tiered wooden box, possibly a chest or jewelry box, resting on four spherical feet. The box is predominantly brown with wood grain texture and features yellow vertical rectangular accents on the corners of each tier. The top tier has a green circular element in the center, possibly a decorative knob or handle, set on a small round base. Each tier appears to have drawers indicated by small round knobs or pulls; the top drawer has two pairs of small yellow circular accents, and the lower drawers each have a single knob in the center. The composition is set against a plain, off-white or beige background with no additional objects or decorative elements visible. The drawing is oriented such that the box appears in three-dimensional perspective. There is a signature or text at the bottom left corner.
title: Box
